The Authentic Name

kórinthos.com appears available

Greek

Κόρινθος

The name in its original Greek form. Κόρινθος carries the full phonetic and orthographic weight of the source tradition.

ASCII Constraint

KORINTHOS

Stripped of its identity, the name was reduced to plain Latin letters. The original orthography — stress, length, breathing — was erased by systems that only understand A-Z.

Unicode Restoration

Kórinthos

The Unicode restoration recovers what ASCII destroyed. This is philological accuracy — not decoration. The domain encodes to Punycode, but the browser displays the truth.

Punycode Encoding
kórinthos.com → xn--krinthos-v3a.com

The non-ASCII characters in Kórinthos are encoded while the ASCII remains visible. To the DNS, it is Punycode. To humanity, it is Kórinthos. This domain appears available per Verisign RDAP, but registry holds, premium listings, or registrar blocks can still prevent registration. Always verify with a registrar.

Tier Classification

Why Kórinthos is classified as Tier-2 Accent-Preserving

The Greek original Κόρινθος contains only stress (acute accent). This makes it a single-tier Tier-2 name. The Unicode restoration preserves what can be preserved — honoring the single feature that distinguishes it from plain ASCII.
